about: Scenes no single girl leads (the player with his friends, teachers, narration), first found on Disc 5 (a scene on several discs is listed under the first). Edit only "en". One entry is one text box; \n separates its lines, and the English needs as many lines as the Japanese. See the README, 'Helping improve the translation'.

Because my late father always
raised me as a boy.
So I told myself I was a guy,

when we ended up in the same class,
I… I fell in love with you.

Seeing you get along with Hikari

だから、
